india.label: Economy · 13 Nov
india.headline: India’s October exports rose to $49.47 billion
india.summary: The Federation of Indian Export Organisations said merchandise exports rose 45.06% year on year in October. Shipments grew in 43 of India’s top 50 export destinations.
india.context: A broad rise across destinations matters more than growth concentrated in one buyer. Check whether volumes and export values grow together in the next release.

india.label: Prices · October CPI
india.headline: Retail inflation moved above 6%
india.summary: India’s provisional consumer inflation reading reached 6.09% in October, up from 5.54% in September. The food index also recorded faster price growth.
india.context: The headline is a national average. Food can account for a larger share of spending for some households, making their experience of inflation different.

india.label: Assam · 13 Nov
india.headline: A bus and truck collided near Kaziranga
india.summary: Authorities said at least 24 people died after a bus collided with a container truck in Assam on Friday, the Associated Press reported.
india.context: The fatality count reflected the reporting available on Friday. The circumstances of the collision were still being established.

india.label: Air quality · 13 Nov
india.headline: Some Delhi monitors recorded severe air quality
india.summary: On Friday, the monitor at AIIMS recorded an AQI of 418 and Rajokri recorded 402, The Indian Express reported. Both readings were in the severe category.
india.context: Pollution can vary within a city. These are station readings, which can differ from the citywide average.

india.label: Trade · 14–27 Nov
india.headline: The India International Trade Fair opens in Delhi
india.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal inaugurated the 45th edition at Bharat Mandapam on Friday. The fair runs from 14 to 27 November.
india.context: The event puts businesses, exporters and artisans in front of buyers. Goyal used the opening to urge Indian firms to explore markets through trade agreements.

world.label: Diplomacy · 14 Nov IST
world.headline: The US and Russia announced plans for a three-way summit
world.summary: The White House and Kremlin said Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin planned to meet on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen.
world.context: The announcement described a planned meeting. The final guest list and agenda would determine how much room there is for substantive talks.

world.label: Climate · 13 Nov
world.headline: COP31 heard urgent calls for climate finance
world.summary: Developing countries sought faster funding for climate action at COP31 in Antalya. Reuters reported limited appetite among wealthier countries to move quickly.
world.context: A funding promise is easier to evaluate when it specifies the amount, payer, recipient and delivery date. Those details matter for planning projects.

world.label: Ukraine · 13 Nov
world.headline: Ukraine anticipates a large prisoner exchange
world.summary: Volodymyr Zelenskyy said a planned exchange with Russia would be the largest of its kind so far, Anadolu reported.
world.context: An exchange announcement offers families a signal of progress. Its scale is clear when the parties complete it and release details.

world.label: Gaza · 13 Nov
world.headline: Israeli strikes killed several people in Gaza
world.summary: Anadolu reported that Israeli strikes killed several people in Gaza. The report was part of its Friday international briefing.
world.context: Reports during conflict can change as information arrives. A subsequent verified update may provide a clearer count and timeline.

world.label: US economy · 13 Nov
world.headline: The US debate over an energy shock and interest rates
world.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee differed on how monetary policy should respond to higher energy prices, Reuters reported.
world.context: Oil prices can raise overall inflation quickly. Policymakers also look for signs that those costs are spreading to wages, other prices and expectations.

markets.label: Indices · 13 Nov close
markets.headline: Nifty ended Friday down 0.61%
markets.summary: Nifty 50 closed at 25,144.30 and Sensex at 81,592.45, down 0.61% and 0.39%, respectively. Regular equity trading was closed on Saturday.
markets.context: Reuters cited elevated oil and domestic inflation as pressures on Friday. Watch whether the next session’s moves are broad or concentrated in a few stocks.

markets.label: Sectors · 13 Nov close
markets.headline: Banks and autos lagged the broader market
markets.summary: Nifty Bank fell 0.79% and Nifty Auto fell 1.07% on Friday. Moneycontrol also reported declines of about 1% in realty and metals.
markets.context: Compare sector performance with each index’s largest constituents. A few heavily weighted names can explain much of an index move.

markets.label: IPO · 13 Nov
markets.headline: Crystal Crop set a ₹259–272 IPO price band
markets.summary: Crystal Crop Protection’s offer was scheduled to open on 18 November. It combines new equity with shares sold by an existing shareholder.
markets.context: The new share issue raises money for the company. The proceeds of the offer for sale go to the selling shareholder. The prospectus explains the split.

markets.label: Commodities · 13 Nov morning
markets.headline: Brent was near $95 and Indian gold near ₹1.36 lakh
markets.summary: Financial Express reported a Friday-morning Brent quote near $95 per barrel and an indicative 24-carat gold price in India of ₹1,36,330 per 10 grams.
markets.context: These quotes are snapshots. Look at when the quote was captured and whether the price is for spot gold, a futures contract or a retail sale.

markets.label: Company results · 13 Nov close
markets.headline: Automotive Axles rose after its quarterly results
markets.summary: Moneycontrol reported that Automotive Axles gained about 10% after releasing its quarterly numbers, even as the benchmark and auto index fell.
markets.context: Check how revenue, margins and cash generation changed. A sharp one-day move can reflect how the report differed from expectations.

tech.label: Models · 12 Nov
tech.headline: Google introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen
tech.summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen for agent-style work, including coding. It described availability through the Gemini app, Search, developer tools and other Google products.
tech.context: The model name alone tells you little about an application. Test how many steps it can complete reliably in the workflow you actually use.

tech.label: Chips · 13 Nov
tech.headline: Nvidia’s leadership change puts its strategy in focus
tech.summary: Nvidia disclosed that its board accepted Jensen Huang’s resignation as CEO. Associated Press reported that the change raised questions for the company and the wider AI industry.
tech.context: Nvidia sells chips plus software and networking that customers rely on. Leadership changes can prompt questions about the roadmap for all three.

tech.label: IT services · 13 Nov
tech.headline: Microsoft 365 outage disrupted Teams and Outlook
tech.summary: A Microsoft 365 outage affected access to Outlook, Teams and other services, Reuters reported. Some connectors used by AI tools were also affected.
tech.context: A cloud dependency can affect many apps at once. Check which workflows still work if the shared identity or collaboration service goes down.

tech.label: Shopping · 13 Nov
tech.headline: Amazon is exploring a wider catalogue for AI shopping
tech.summary: Reuters reviewed an internal document describing a World Product Graph to collect data about products sold across the web, including items Amazon does not stock.
tech.context: A shopping assistant needs structured data to compare items. The company with better catalogue coverage may shape what its agents can find.

tech.label: AI agents · 13 Nov
tech.headline: ChatGPT Wallet begins a limited US rollout
tech.summary: OpenAI announced a wallet for approved agent purchases. The initial release was for eligible US ChatGPT Pro subscribers using dots.
tech.context: The ability to approve a purchase matters more than an agent’s ability to suggest one. The proposed purchase and the total price need to be clear at approval.

mind.label: Learning science
mind.headline: Space your practice if you want it to stick
mind.summary: A review of verbal-memory studies found that spreading practice sessions improved long-term recall, with the useful gap depending partly on when the learner would be tested.
mind.context: Review a new concept over several days, then try recalling it from memory. Adjust the gap to the date you want to remember it.

mind.label: Choice psychology
mind.headline: The frame can change which risk feels acceptable
mind.summary: Tversky and Kahneman found that people could prefer different options when equivalent outcomes were expressed as gains or losses.
mind.context: When a choice sounds especially appealing, rewrite both options using the same baseline and units. See whether the preference survives the change in wording.

mind.label: Habits
mind.headline: Give the habit a cue you can recognise
mind.summary: Research on implementation intentions studied plans that specify both a situation and an action. An example is opening today’s briefing after setting down breakfast.
mind.context: Choose a cue that already occurs each day, then attach one simple action. The cue reminds you to start without needing a new decision each time.

mind.label: Evolutionary biology
mind.headline: One E. coli lineage found a new way to use citrate
mind.summary: In the long-term E. coli experiment, one lineage evolved the ability to use citrate in oxygenated conditions. Revisiting frozen earlier populations helped researchers trace steps that made the change possible.
mind.context: An earlier mutation can make a later possibility accessible. Evolution’s outcomes can depend on the order in which changes occur.

mind.label: Evolutionary genetics
mind.headline: Sticklebacks changed where a gene was expressed
mind.summary: Research traced reduced pelvic structures in some freshwater sticklebacks to changes associated with reduced expression of the Pitx1 gene in the developing pelvis.
mind.context: Evolution can change when or where a gene acts. That can affect a specific body part while preserving other uses of the same gene.

marketing.label: India · Partner campaign · 13 Nov
marketing.headline: Turtlemint moved partner payouts earlier for Diwali
marketing.summary: Turtlemint paired a social film with an operational change. It brought forward base motor-insurance payouts for eligible sales partners and used the film to show what timely earnings could mean during the festival.
marketing.context: A campaign can make a brand promise tangible through something the business does. Identify a point where changing the timing of a service would help the audience.

marketing.label: India · Product films · 5 Nov
marketing.headline: Birla Opus dramatized the cost of putting off waterproofing
marketing.summary: Birla Opus and BBDO India made three films that show people delaying waterproofing until the trouble becomes visible. Everyday moments make the consequences of waiting easier to picture.
marketing.context: Show the effect of procrastination in a scene the audience recognises. It makes a preventive product benefit more concrete.

marketing.label: India · Public outreach · 13–15 Nov
marketing.headline: Diabetes 360 brought experts to regional digital channels
marketing.summary: Swasthya Plus Network’s Bhubaneswar-led campaign used interviews, educational videos and web stories. It distributed them through the platforms of Swasthya Plus Odia, OdishaLIVE and IFI Foundation.
marketing.context: For a public-interest message, combine subject experts with channels people in the community already use. Adapt the format to how each channel’s audience learns.

marketing.label: Global · US brand film · 2 Nov
marketing.headline: Nordstrom gave a holiday gathering a Bowie soundtrack
marketing.summary: The retailer built a holiday film around “Let’s Dance,” using a living-room dance scene to showcase the shared experience of gifting. The campaign used streaming TV as well as the retailer’s own channels.
marketing.context: A familiar piece of music can cue a mood quickly. Choose a track that supports an action viewers can imagine themselves taking.

marketing.label: Global · Oman outreach · 13 Nov
marketing.headline: A diabetes outreach day took screening into the community
marketing.summary: A World Diabetes Day event in Suhar was designed to combine screening and public education at a local outreach event. Its organiser used a global observance to give residents a specific place and date to act.
marketing.context: A global awareness day offers a reason to pay attention. A local appointment or concrete activity gives people a next step.
